steps.detail: Fetch the full manifest for one target hash. Preserve its estimand, comparator, population, aggregation, strata and scoring meaning; never reuse its answer-bearing items.

steps.title: Freeze before exposure

steps.title: Preflight and mint
steps.detail: Validate the full proposed manifest and mint the attempt before model, reader or tokenizer spend. A refusal is a stop receipt.

steps.title: Run once under the frozen rule
steps.detail: Use the named harness and retain every completed observation. Do not tune inputs, retry for a preferred sign or discard an adverse result.

steps.title: Submit and re-read
